reviews.text: The Banfield Pet Hospital staff were all so caring and treated my husky as if she was theirs. The Veterinarian, Dr. Martinson who preformed the teeth cleaning procedure was also very caring. She knew I was concerned about sedation and kept me informed from start to finish. She called me after the procedure to tell me how my husky did and that everything went well. Next day I had questions and she took the time to talk to me personally instead of having staff rely any message. I highly recommend Banfield in Lakewood, Dallas.
Awesome staff! They made the visit quick amd easy. The wait time was super fast
Staff is amazing and friendly. I have been bringing my dog for a few years now and have nothing but excellent service!
Dr. Osadiaye at PetSmart is fantastic! His bedside manner is excellent, and he is extremely knowledgeable. He expertly handled my 1.5-year-old dog's eye allergies. We highly recommend him!
Dr. Thorne was very knowledgeable and very proactive on treating kennel cough in my dog.

1 star since they were able to get my dog in, however I wouldn’t recommend this location to any pet owner. The manager Celia, was not pleasant on the phone and felt the need to go back and forth over my dogs condition. The Vet assistant lied on the phone, the other assistant who was “treating” my dog, didn’t have any knowledge as to what was going on. Dr. Thorne, wouldn’t trust her with my dog again based off her interactions on the phone. She sighed during any question I asked her, as I told her the Vet Assistant was not confident on the phone to go over my dogs conditions. I was told he was “ok” but then prescribed different treatments. Dr. Thorne made a nasty comment about the cost instead of explaining. As my dog is my ESA & Service Animal, I wouldn’t trust the Manager Celia, the Hispanic male Vet Assistant, nor Dr. Thorne again with my dog.

A second star for the kind receptionist and staff, otherwise I wouldn't recommend bringing your pet here.
I booked an appointment that specifically said in-room on the time slot and when I arrived they considered it a drop off which was a hard no.
My dog is anxious and cannot be left alone so I waited for two and a half hours because the vet was operating on other animals DURING my scheduled appointment time.
Then to make things worse, they still didn't allow me to come to the back with my dog when it came "time" which created a lot of tension for me as he is my emotional support animal.
When the vet came back, I felt rushed as she stated she "made time for me" to come speak with me about my dog's condition while she informs me his heart is failing from heartworms, has no patience to explain to me my options and just reiterated her opinion on what she would do, which at the time seemed reasonable until I researched and called other local veterinarians and the method she suggested for my dogs condition is NOT recommended by the American Heartworm Society.
This has been an awful waste of time and money as I've been using GoFundMe donations to help my dog and they knew this and still made this an uncomfortable experience for both of us.
To put a cherry on top, they gave my dog back to me with trimmed nails, which I did not ask for and they cut his wick. Talk about "professional" and completely neglected to mention whether he needed his glands cleaned or not even when I asked them to check.
This has been stressful enough, I appreciate the effort but it wasn't even close to the mark. We felt like a number, not a patient.

Took my newly rescued dog to the vet here for what was supposed to be just a general visit. My rescue started coughing and sneezing a few days before the appt. The staff here is great and you can tell they really care about the pets. Thank you for getting my boy on the mend!! Purchased a package for wellness great deal!!

We love Banfield and trust them fully with our two frenchies! Dr. Thorne does a great job of explaining and communicating everything we ask about. Every staff member has always greeted us and made us feel welcome. They're the best!
They worked fast to get us in the back. They explained everything to us, treated our dog with top priority care!

I brought the lack of emergency triage at Banfield Lakewood to corporate. Their response shows zero accountability:
* Insensitive Comparison: The regional Chief Executive called to offer condolences but inappropriately compared my fresh grief to her own personal experiences.
* No Staff Penalties: It became clear no one will be held accountable for this tragedy—not the receptionist, manager, or hospital staff.
* Surface-Level Fixes: They claim they will now train receptionists and print emergency facility addresses. This proves no protocol existed prior to this tragedy.
* Insulting Offer: To "help with the pain," they offered to cancel my wellness plan and cover the remaining contract balance.
Canceling a balance does not bring back Lucia, our loved family member. This clinic lacks basic emergency protocols, and corporate does not take fatal negligence seriously. Be very careful trusting your pets to Banfield.

*Saturday May 09, 2026–LUCIA*
This was the worst day of my life. I woke up and took my baby Lucia to the park to walk. After walking a little, Lucia was making a loud sound and stopped for me to carry her. I grabbed her and told her we were going home. She kept doing the noise and looked tired. I decided to turn around and took Lucia to her personal veterinarian, Banfield Hospital Lakewood. There was NOBODY at the front desk. NO RECEPTIONIST in service.
After 10 mins, a young Hispanic female came out. She was wearing black scrub pants with a black regular shirt. She said, “how can I help you.” I stated to her, “Hi I don’t have an appointment, but this is an emergency. I was walking my little dog and she is making a loud breathing noise and I see her weak.” She said, “oh, hold on just one second.” She went to the back and came back within five mins or less. Her exact words: “I’m sorry the doctor is in surgery, she said to take her to another Banfield Hospital or the emergency room. Because that’s not good.” My head was not all there. This is my first pet. I didn’t know where to go. I asked her where the closest Banfield was. She said, “there is one on Greenville Ave and one on Forest.” I looked at her, said thank you, and left.
Scared and confused, I started driving. Before I got out of the parking lot, I remembered a Banfield Hospital in Mesquite. I started driving to Mesquite and Lucia was still weak. I kept driving and told Lucia, “it’s ok baby we will be there in a minute,” and kissed her. Lucia started making the breathing noise again. I had Lucia in my arms. I called my sister who lives in Mesquite and told her to meet me at the Banfield Hospital in Mesquite because Lucia was not doing good. In my way driving, I felt Lucia like she was drained. I don’t even know how I got to the Mesquite clinic.
My sister and I arrived at the same time to the parking lot. We walked into Banfield Hospital Mesquite and explained the whole situation. The front desk was quick to assist us. She offered us a room and immediately called the doctor. The doctor and her assistant came to see us, but Lucia had left us. I was devastated and very confused. I asked the doctor, “what could you have done if she got here first?” The doctor stated, “stabilize her, then send her to the emergency room.”
I am very disappointed in Banfield Lakewood. Their job was to assist my baby. No help was given to me and no one guided me with knowledge or experience. The clinic has to have someone to assess the situation or a nurse as a backup while the doctor is in surgery. Terrible service, unprofessional, inexperienced, unethical, inhumane. Lucia went to that clinic for eight years. I want to know who made the decision to send my baby away. The situation was workable according to the doctor in Mesquite. My baby is gone and I am destroyed emotionally. Lucia was a member of our family and a companion. On top of all this, they sent me an email and a voicemail to confirm her appointment for Friday, May 15, 2026.
Hi Fahmida - We're grateful for your review of our pet hospital! Your positive experience motivates us to do even better.
Thanks for trusting us with your BFF 🧡 We appreciate the review! …
Thank you "fur" the review! 🐕 …
Banfield veterinary services are wonderful. Staff are caring professionals who take time for explanations.
Pets love going to Banfield like kids like going to The Fair!

Do NOT bring your pet here.

I came to this location out of desperation.  my dog had a cut that needed to be checked out, and they were able to get me in same day. That was the only positive thing I can say.

From the moment we arrived, the staff communication was virtually nonexistent. The doctor and assistant could not answer a single question I had about my dog's condition or treatment plan. Despite that, they insisted she needed emergency surgery and told me to bring her in the very next day, yet could not explain why the surgery was necessary, what it involved, or what the risks were. They also sent me home with medication without being able to confirm whether it was actually needed.

When I arrived the following morning for her drop-off, there was nobody at the front desk to check her in, even after I had called ahead to let them know I was on my way. At that point, I made the decision to leave and seek a second opinion.

I went to our primary Banfield on Forest Lane, where they examined her thoroughly and confirmed that sedation and stitches were not necessary at all.

This clinic pushed unnecessary emergency surgery on my dog, failed to communicate even the most basic information, and couldn't staff their front desk for a scheduled procedure. I shudder to think what would have happened if I hadn't trusted my gut and walked away.

Please do yourself and your pet a favor, go anywhere else.
Hi Jose - We're grateful for your review of our pet hospital! Your positive experience motivates us to do even better.

Lakewood location: Dr Thorne is an absolute gem. She goes beyond care for our 6 animals. Annabel at the front desk is super friendly. Their website has some room for improvement, but our animals are in excellent care here.

If I could leave 0 stars I would! The service receptionist at the front desk was very rude and unkind to me on my visit with my pup. She has a nasty horrible attitude and should not be representing your company. I spend a lot of money and time here with my pup and now I want to switch to a different facility. I no longer want to be serviced here !!! Then I hear her talking to someone in the back saying rude comments about me! This is not a good look!

These people tried to scam me out of $650. And two of the vets are arguing about if my cats old enough to get spade right in front of me. Not to mention the surgery I had scheduled with a quote price of $600 actually turned to $1200 the day of. And for the $650 they tried to scam me out of. They never texted me called me or communicated I owed them anything before sending me to debt collections which I didn’t end up having to pay because these people didn’t treat my cat at all. These people suck.

Shortened version: 2 vets argue in front of my about what should be done to my cat in surgery, price of surgery is double what was quoted so the surgery didn’t happen, 6 months later debt collectors are coming after me for a vet bill when my cat was never treated.

Took my almost 10 year old chihuahua here for the first time this afternoon. Absolutely blown away by the friendliness they showed me and the tender care they gave my sweet girl. We just moved so I was very nervous about bringing her to a new location- my anxiety was eased immediately. I cannot speak highly enough about every single person I interacted with during our appointment, I am so relieved to have found a new vet home for my baby. If you need a place to take your pet with full confidence that they will be treated well and all your questions/concerns will be answered with kindness and digestible explanations, this is the place for you. They've got clients in us for as long as we're here!

The staff here are awesome because they genuinely care about my cat. The customer service is incredible. Nicole at the front desk is very sweet and helpful, and I feel relieved knowing Natalie is taking such great care of Thomas. She is very helpful, knowledgeable, and professional. I truly trust them with his care.
Your review has brightened our day! We're happy to see that you and your pet had a great experience with us.

Dr. Thorn and the entire staff are INCREDIBLE!!!  Our silly dog ate a whole box of sugar free gum and started having a seizure.  Dr. Thorn monitored him, gave him glucose supplements, and liver supplements until he was out of the woods!  The office is clean, friendly, and prompt. We can't thank you and your entire team enough!

I have had nothing but great experiences with Banfield and can’t say enough positive things about the staff - everyone, every tech, and Dr.Thorne have been incredible. My dog loves the staff and gets excited when we come here (even after his neuter!)

Dr. Thorne is truly one of a kind! She saved my German Shepherd puppy Nova’s life and treated her as if she were her own pet. From the moment we met, I felt supported, loved, and completely safe in her care. Dr. Thorne went above and beyond for Nova, and her compassion, skill, and dedication mean the world to me. I will never go to anyone else she’s the absolute best!
Very friendly, answered all my questions, end of it was very to the point of what I needed to do, in which I appreciate.

We left our Plano Banfield, our home for over 10 years, after we finally bought our home in South Dallas. I found the Lakewood location immediately after our move, which so happened to be right after we got our 2nd baby, a puppy. Dr. Thorne & the staff have been AMAAAAAAAAZING! We have 2 poodles, Penny & Phoebe, that have been with Lakewood now over a year and even though they do not like going to the vet, I KNOW they are in great hands!!!
Great service and great communication!
Thanks for the pawsitive review!
Thanks for the pawsitive review!
Thank you "fur" the review! 🐕 …
Thank you "fur" the review! 🐕 …

Booked an appointment for same day because I was concerned about my dog who I pay monthly to Banfield for their Wellness plan. I was called by the receptionist and told the online booking portal was wrong and they can’t see him until 2 days from now for drop off only even though he is ill. They had at least 6 open appointments for same-day showing. Fix your system. I’m canceling my wellness plan and will find a vet that cares.

They have changed their policy regarding heartworm medication and are now requiring your dog to be seen every 6 months just to get heartworm prevention. It used to be once a year. It’s clear this is only for profit and I feel like it’s absolutely ridiculous that once a year isn’t sufficient. No HEALTHY adult dog needs to be seen every 6 months. Instead of people actually coming in more often, I guarantee this policy will have the opposite effect and actually turn people away, resulting in more dogs going WITHOUT heartworm prevention. This was the last straw for me and I will be taking my dog to a local private practice without these BS policies. Also, whenever they did actually fill her heartworm last time, it was basically impossible to get them to do it. Had to call them 10+ times and it took over a month.

I was so nervous when I took my cat in to get treated and vaccinated but the staff was so gentle, sweet, funny and caring that I will only bring my pet here. I was absolutely amazed and relieved with the outcome. This location and all of the staff are awesome. Thank you all for making this a stress free event.

The staff at Banfield in Lakewood are so awesome. The treated my dog, Fergus, like their family.  I want to make a special call out for Dr. Thorne.  Fergus was an older dog and started to have health issues later in life. Dr. Thorne was always very honest and also very compassionate when sharing diagnosis and options. Very recently, it was time to let Fergus go, and Dr. Thorne was with me the entire way, helping me through one of the most difficult things I've ever had to do. I will get another dog eventually, and I will definitely take them to Lakewood Banfield and Dr. Thorne for all their care needs.
Your review has brightened our day! We're happy to see that you and your pet had a great experience with us.
Glad we made your experience a good one—thanks for the review! 🧡🐾 …

My dog has received great care across the Banfield system in the past 12 years. They are great at routine care and treating minor ailments but I've noticed that when major issues come up, they are not equipped to manage or recommend next steps. My dog is currently in stage 3 of Kidney disease. Banfield recommended I start administrating fluids myself and gave me a website with video instructions.  I am grateful for this observation but later learned via specialist that I need an RX with dose amount and should have a technician demonstrate how to do this properly the first time. I would have had no issues if Banfield says they cannot provide this type of support and recommends I follow up with a specialist to evaluate my dog and prescribe treatment. My issue is with recommending a treatment that should be prescribed by a vet with a specific dose and show step by step correct way to administer. This specific visit felt overwhelming and stressful.

We brought our new kitten in yesterday & the staff was so friendly. Dr. Carter & her tech Ruby were so helpful. As a new cat owner Ruby went over everything I needed to know with shots and keeping her healthy! Thank y'all so much, look forward to seeing y'all in a few weeks!
Wet friendly and educated staff

Ruby was AWESOMEE, she made sure we were well taken care of and was so patient and caring with our crazy puppy. Banfield is so lucky to have her, we always look forward to going in and seeing Miss Ruby. Thank you so much to the staff for being so welcoming and awesome. Huge shoutout to Ruby!

This location is turning everything into profit. I have been to multiple banfields and have never accumulated such bills. I tell them exactly what he needs  and his past issues  and they find multiple ways to charge unnecessary charges. They want to take the easy way out instead of putting the dogs health over their personal comfort level. Im reaching out to corporate to discuss my experience. Then had the audacity to try to bait me into an argument. The entire conversation was recorded. Do not go here!!

Dr. Thorn and her staff were incredibly gracious in helping me handle the loss of my dog. They were informative, gave me options, and ensured that I had everything I needed both before and on the day that I said goodbye to my best friend. Nothing about the situation was easy, but I can’t stress how much better they made the experience. Thank y’all for your help.

Called separate location to be able to pickup prescription for dog at this location. The other location put in the notes that we were approved to go to this location. We called to make sure and Susie says she sees the note but “needs to hear it from the other location directly”. Terrible customer service basically saying you’re trying to turn away customers. Thank god there’s other locations. This place is terrible as this is the second time in a year they’ve done something similar over the phone.

This location has quickly gone down hill in the last 6 months or so. Starting with cancelling my appointment once I already arrived due to “system errors”, to an extremely confused and unprofessional staff. To my most recent experience.

I called last week needing an appointment for an eye infection. First appointment was 5 days later but I had to wait so I just tried my best at home remedies.

I was told the only option was a drop off appointment. I dropped my dog off at 9:30am for his 10am appointment. Was told he would be ready within a couple hours.

1pm came around and I called and I was told he was not seen yet. Waited 2 more hours and he still wasn’t seen. At 3pm they told me to come in 45 minutes.

Keep in mind he was in a cage for 7 hours at this point. They then returned him to me covered in his own pee ( since he had not been let outside for 7 hours ) and extremely thirsty he drank 4 bowls of water when he got home.

They told me they couldn’t perform any of the exam because he was agitated *duh he was in a cage for 7 hours and had to pee on himself*. Also, it’s an eye infection. Not hard to to a visual exam? Give my dog a treat or two and he’s best friends with anyone. We quite literally take him to work with us and just let him walk around and greet customers. He meets dozens of new people a day.

I am going to make sure and share this information with Banfield corporate and the board of veterinary medicine because I am truly concerned for animals well being at this location. I highly recommend going somewhere else.
Friendly and informative staff.  👌 …

I'm posting my review because it's important for people to understand that this banfield is a great place for your pets.
They care about it and go the extra mile to get information or the help you need.
Special thanks to Melissa for going above and beyond to help me with all that I needed in order to keep my dog healthy and safe.
Thanks also to all the crew for being kind, thanks also to Celia for always helping me schedule my pet when the week is busy always being kind  patient and accommodating. If you love and care for your pet, bring them here, once again, thanks very much for your help always.

three years I have been bringing my dog angel here the staff is professional never had problems with any of them I trust them after my baby waking up after having surgery she got her teeth cleaned  so five stars for me
Always a pleasure visiting and bringing my fury baby to see the doctor. She is handled with  prestige care.
Hi Armando - We're grateful for your review of our pet hospital! Your positive experience motivates us to do even better.
Always a great experience
This hospital has shown excellent compassion and concern for all 3 of our kittens. Treated our kittens so kindly. I love the professional yet animal loving nature of this facility.

Dr. Thorne is wonderful! She's caring, attentive, and knowledgeable. She takes time to get to know your pet. My dog has heart disease and she has treated him like her own dog. The entire Banfield team is great!
It was a pleasure caring for your furry friend. Thanks for the great rating!
Hi, does anyone know if there's a specific day when they speak Spanish? I have two puppies that need to be spayed. Thanks.
